retrievalProfile.description: Produces a gritty, low-key photographic portrait paired with top-aligned, geometric sans-serif typography and horizontal rule accents.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist digital aesthetics are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A moody, low-light photographic composition featuring a primary subject in the foreground and a secondary subject in the background, characterized by deep shadows and a top-right justified typographic block underlined by thin rules.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground subject dominates the left two-thirds of the frame
Secondary subject provides environmental context in the lower right
Typography is anchored to the top right corner
Horizontal rules separate and define the text hierarchy
coreInvariants: Low-key lighting with high contrast shadows
Thin horizontal rules integrated with typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is a medium close-up on the left; secondary subject is a smaller, seated figure in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The primary subject's face and the bright white of their clothing.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the primary subject's face, down to the secondary figure, then up to the text block in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep, dark shadows in the background create a sense of depth and grit.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark blues in the background shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and skin tones of the subjects.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted reds and warm highlights on the skin.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the white clothing and dark background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or vibrant synthetic colors

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with varying weights and sizes, separated by rules.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rules extending from the text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and tight tracking of the era.
Provides the necessary geometric weight and sharp corners.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key, gritty photographic portrait of a man in a white tank top on the left, with a secondary person in the background on the right, using deep shadows and 1980s film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of bold geometric sans-serif text in the top right corner, right-aligned, with thin horizontal lines underlining the first and second lines.

verificationChecks: Are there horizontal rules integrated with the text?
Is the lighting low-key with deep shadows?
Is the font a geometric sans-serif?

mustAchieve: High contrast between subject and background

postGenerationChecks: Verify right-alignment of all text elements
Ensure horizontal rules are perfectly straight
Confirm deep shadow depth in background
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key portrait + Geometric Sans-Serif + Right-aligned hierarchy + Horizontal rules
